def.short: the room in a home where you wash, and often where the toilet is
def.long: The room in a home where you take a bath or a shower and wash your hands. In American English it is also a polite word for the room with the toilet.

examples.en: The bathroom is next to my bedroom.
examples.tr: Banyo yatak odamın yanında.

examples.en: Mehmet is in the bathroom. He is brushing his teeth.
examples.tr: Mehmet banyoda. Dişlerini fırçalıyor.

examples.en: Our hotel room has a big bathroom with a bath.
examples.tr: Otel odamızın küvetli büyük bir banyosu var.

tr.note: Amerikan İngilizcesinde 'bathroom' tuvalet yerine de kullanılır: 'Where is the bathroom?' tuvalet nerede demektir. İngiliz İngilizcesinde bunun için 'toilet' denir.

mistakes.wrong: Ali is in bathroom. Please wait.
mistakes.right: Ali is in the bathroom. Please wait.
mistakes.why: Türkçede 'banyoda' dersiniz; 'the' gibi bir sözcük yoktur. İngilizcede bilinen bir yer için 'the bathroom' denir.

quiz.cloze: I brush my teeth and take a shower in the ______ every morning.

def.micro: land by a house with plants
def.short: a piece of land next to a house where people grow flowers, plants, or food
def.long: A piece of land next to a house where people grow flowers, trees, or vegetables, or sit outside. Many people have a small garden behind their house.

examples.en: The children are playing in the garden.
examples.tr: Çocuklar bahçede oynuyor.

examples.en: Ayşe grows tomatoes in her garden.
examples.tr: Ayşe bahçesinde domates yetiştiriyor.

examples.en: We had dinner in the garden on a warm night.
examples.tr: Sıcak bir gecede akşam yemeğini bahçede yedik.

etymology.text: From Old North French 'gardin'. It comes from a Germanic word for a fenced area and is related to 'yard'.

tr.note: İngiltere'de ev bahçesine 'garden' denir. Amerikan İngilizcesinde ev bahçesi 'yard', çiçek ve sebze ekilen yer ise 'garden' olur. Halka açık yeşil alan 'park' demektir.

quiz.cloze: We sat outside in the ______ and ate under the trees.

def.micro: opening in a wall with glass
def.short: an opening in a wall or a car, usually with glass, that lets in light and air
def.long: An opening in the wall of a building, or in a car, usually filled with glass. You open it to let in air and close it when it is cold or noisy.

examples.en: Our kitchen has a big window.
examples.tr: Mutfağımızın büyük bir penceresi var.

examples.en: Elif sat by the window and looked at the rain.
examples.tr: Elif pencerenin yanında oturup yağmura baktı.

examples.en: I always close the window before I go to bed.
examples.tr: Her gece yatmadan önce pencereyi kapatırım.

etymology.text: From Old Norse 'vindauga', which means 'wind eye': 'vindr' (wind) + 'auga' (eye).

tr.note: Mağaza vitrini 'shop window', bilgisayardaki pencere de 'window' olur. Trende ya da uçakta cam kenarı koltuğa 'window seat' denir.

mistakes.right: She looked out of the window.
mistakes.why: Türkçede 'pencereden baktı' (çıkma hâli, -den) dersiniz, bu yüzden 'from' denir. İngilizcede 'look out of the window' (ya da 'look out the window') denir.

quiz.cloze: She sat next to the ______ on the train and watched the fields go by.

def.short: a common food made from flour, water, and yeast that is baked in an oven
def.long: A common food made from flour and water that is baked in an oven. It is uncountable: say 'a slice of bread' or 'a loaf of bread', not 'a bread'.

examples.en: I'd like some bread with my soup.
examples.tr: Çorbamla biraz ekmek istiyorum.

examples.en: Mehmet buys fresh bread every morning.
examples.tr: Mehmet her sabah taze ekmek alıyor.

examples.en: Please cut two slices of bread for me.
examples.tr: Lütfen benim için iki dilim ekmek kes.

tr.note: Türkçede 'bir ekmek', 'iki ekmek' dersiniz; İngilizcede 'bread' sayılamaz. Bir somun için 'a loaf of bread', bir dilim için 'a slice of bread' denir.

mistakes.right: I bought two loaves of bread.
mistakes.why: Türkçede 'iki ekmek' dersiniz; İngilizcede 'bread' sayılamaz, -s almaz. Sayı için 'loaf' (somun) ya da 'slice' (dilim) kullanılır: two loaves of bread.

mistakes.wrong: Can I have a bread, please?
mistakes.right: Can I have some bread, please?
mistakes.why: Türkçede 'bir ekmek' dersiniz, bu yüzden 'a bread' denir. İngilizcede 'bread' sayılamaz, 'a' almaz: some bread, a slice of bread.

quiz.cloze: We need some ______ for breakfast, so Ayşe is buying a loaf at the bakery.

def.short: small grains that you cook in water and eat as food
def.long: Small white or brown grains that are cooked in water and eaten with meat, fish, or vegetables. It is uncountable: we say 'a bowl of rice', not 'a rice'.

examples.en: I'd like chicken and rice, please.
examples.tr: Tavuk ve pilav istiyorum lütfen.

examples.en: Elif cooks a big pot of rice on Sundays.
examples.tr: Elif pazar günleri büyük bir tencere pilav pişiriyor.

examples.en: We need to buy rice and sugar at the market.
examples.tr: Pazardan pirinç ve şeker almamız lazım.

etymology.text: From Old French 'ris', which came from Italian 'riso'. The Italian word comes from Latin and Greek 'oryza'.

tr.note: Türkçede çiğ taneye 'pirinç', pişmiş yemeğe 'pilav' dersiniz; İngilizcede ikisi de 'rice' olur. Sayılamaz bir isimdir: 'a rice' denmez.

quiz.cloze: We cook small white grains in water and eat them with chicken. This food is ______.

def.micro: the part of an animal we eat
def.short: the soft part of an animal that people eat as food, such as beef or lamb
def.long: The soft part of an animal's body that people eat, such as beef, lamb, or chicken. It is uncountable: say 'some meat' or 'a piece of meat', not 'a meat'.

examples.en: I don't eat meat, but I eat fish.
examples.tr: Et yemiyorum ama balık yiyorum.

examples.en: Mehmet cooked the meat with onions and tomatoes.
examples.tr: Mehmet eti soğan ve domatesle pişirdi.

examples.en: The butcher on our street sells very good meat.
examples.tr: Sokağımızdaki kasap çok iyi et satıyor.

etymology.text: From Old English 'mete', which once meant any food, not only animal flesh.

tr.note: 'Meat' sayılamaz: 'meats' denmez. Balık 'fish' olarak ayrı sayılır, 'meat' içine girmez. Sığır eti 'beef', kuzu eti 'lamb', koyun eti 'mutton' olur.

quiz.cloze: Hasan is a vegetarian, so he doesn't eat ______ or fish.

def.micro: bird kept for eggs and meat
def.short: a farm bird that gives us eggs and meat; also the meat from this bird
def.long: A farm bird that gives us eggs and meat. The word also means the meat of this bird: as food it is uncountable, so say 'some chicken' or 'chicken soup'.

examples.en: We're having chicken for dinner.
examples.tr: Akşam yemeğinde tavuk yiyoruz.

examples.en: Ali's grandmother keeps ten chickens in her garden.
examples.tr: Ali'nin büyükannesi bahçesinde on tavuk besliyor.

examples.en: Elif made chicken soup because her son was sick.
examples.tr: Elif oğlu hasta olduğu için tavuk çorbası yaptı.

tr.note: Yemek olarak 'chicken' sayılamaz: 'some chicken'. Hayvan olarak sayılabilir: 'a chicken', 'two chickens'. Horoza 'rooster', civcive 'chick' denir.

mistakes.wrong: Two chicken are in the yard.
mistakes.right: Two chickens are in the yard.
mistakes.why: Türkçede sayıdan sonra çoğul eki gelmez ('iki tavuk'). Hayvan olan 'chicken' sayılabilir olduğu için İngilizcede 'two chickens' denir.

quiz.cloze: It is a farm bird. It gives us eggs, and we also eat its meat. It is a ______.

def.short: the sweet food that grows on trees or plants, such as apples and oranges
def.long: The sweet food that grows on trees and plants, such as apples, oranges, and bananas. It is usually uncountable: say 'some fruit' or 'a piece of fruit'.

grammar.pattern: some fruit / a piece of fruit

examples.en: I eat fruit every day.
examples.tr: Her gün meyve yerim.

examples.en: Mehmet bought some fresh fruit at the market.
examples.tr: Mehmet pazardan taze meyve aldı.

examples.en: Apples, bananas, and oranges are my favorite fruit.
examples.tr: Elma, muz ve portakal en sevdiğim meyveler.

etymology.text: From Old French 'fruit', which came from Latin 'fructus', meaning 'enjoyment' or 'produce'.

tr.note: Türkçede 'meyveler' çoğul olarak sık söylenir; İngilizcede 'fruit' genelde sayılamaz ve tekil kalır: 'I like fruit.' Tek bir meyve için 'a piece of fruit' denir.

mistakes.why: Türkçede 'meyveleri severim' diyebilirsiniz, bu yüzden 'fruits' denir. İngilizcede genel anlamda 'fruit' kullanılır; 'fruits' yalnızca farklı meyve türleri için söylenir.

quiz.cloze: Apples, oranges, and bananas are all ______, and they are good for you.

def.short: a plant or part of a plant that you eat, such as carrots, potatoes, or onions
def.long: A plant or part of a plant that people eat, usually with the main part of a meal. Carrots, potatoes, onions, and spinach are common vegetables.

examples.en: Eat your vegetables, Ali.
examples.tr: Sebzelerini ye, Ali.

examples.en: Ayşe cooks rice with fresh vegetables.
examples.tr: Ayşe taze sebzelerle pilav pişiriyor.

examples.en: Carrots are my favorite vegetable.
examples.tr: Havuç en sevdiğim sebzedir.

tr.note: Türkçede domates ve salatalık sebze sayılır. İngilizcede 'fruit' sayılamazken 'vegetable' sayılabilirdir: 'a vegetable', 'vegetables'.

mistakes.why: Türkçede 'sebze severim' dersiniz, çoğul eki yoktur. İngilizcede 'vegetable' sayılabilirdir; genel olarak konuşurken 'vegetables' denir.

quiz.cloze: Carrots, potatoes, and onions are all ______.

def.micro: food you eat at one time
def.short: the food that you eat at one time, such as breakfast, lunch, or dinner
def.long: The food that you eat at one time, for example in the morning, at midday, or in the evening. Most people have three meals a day.

examples.en: Dinner is my favorite meal of the day.
examples.tr: Akşam yemeği günün en sevdiğim öğünü.

examples.en: Hana cooked a big meal for all her friends.
examples.tr: Hana bütün arkadaşları için büyük bir yemek pişirdi.

examples.en: Don't eat between meals. It is bad for your teeth.
examples.tr: Öğünler arasında bir şey yeme. Dişlerine zararlı.

etymology.text: From Old English 'mǣl', which meant 'a fixed time'. A meal was the food you ate at a fixed time.

tr.note: 'Öğün' kahvaltı, öğle ve akşam yemeği gibi bir kerede yenen yemektir. İngilizcede 'meal' sayılabilir: 'three meals a day'. Genel olarak yiyecekler için 'food' denir.

mistakes.wrong: I eat three meal a day.
mistakes.right: I eat three meals a day.
mistakes.why: Türkçede 'günde üç öğün' dersiniz; sayıdan sonra çoğul eki yoktur. İngilizcede 'three meals' gerekir.
Türkçede 'yemek' hem tek bir öğünü hem yiyecekleri anlatır ('Türk yemekleri'). İngilizcede 'meal' bir öğündür; yiyecekler için 'food' denir.

quiz.cloze: Breakfast, lunch, and dinner are the three main ______ of the day.
